caption: A piece of chalk is drawn in a large circle across a blackboard, and a white line appears where it has passed.

sa.check: A piece of chalk is drawn across a blackboard.
It is moved in a large circle.
A white line appears where it has passed.
The line traces the circle the chalk made.
The chalk moves first and the line appears behind it.

pc.expect: The line grows at the chalk tip and only while the chalk is touching the board.
pc.fail: A length of line appears ahead of the chalk tip; or a line appears where the chalk has been lifted clear of the board; or the chalk is drawn across the board leaving no mark at all.

pc.expect: The part of the line already drawn stays where it is for the rest of the clip.
pc.fail: A drawn part of the line fades away; or a drawn part shifts to another place on the board; or the whole line disappears and is laid down again.

pc.expect: The shape on the board matches the path the chalk travelled.
pc.fail: The line on the board is a different shape from the path the chalk took; or the circle closes before the chalk has gone all the way round; or the line jumps across a gap the chalk never crossed.

pc.expect: The chalk leaves a dusty, slightly broken mark and dust falls from the tip down the face of the board.
pc.fail: The line is laid down as an even glowing stripe with no dusty texture; or dust rises upward from the tip and stays up; or the chalk bends or melts against the board.

pc.expect: One piece of chalk and one board are there throughout.
pc.fail: The chalk vanishes mid-stroke or a second piece appears; or the chalk passes through the board; or the chalk turns into another object.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The line's colour and the board's surface stay the same.
pc.fail: The drawn line changes colour after it is laid down; or the board changes colour behind the line; or the frame and the things around the board rearrange.
